  [inst_2 : Fintype.{max u_4 u_2} (Etingof.ArrowsOutOf.{u_2, u_4} Q i)],
  And
    (Etingof.RightExactFunctor.{max (max (max u_1 (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)) (u_2 + 1),
        max (max (max u_1 (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)) (u_2 + 1), max (max u_3 u_4) u_2, max (max u_3 u_4) u_2}

        max (max (max u_1 (u_5 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)) (u_2 + 1), max (max u_5 u_4) u_2, max (max u_5 u_4) u_2}
      (Etingof.reflectionFunctorPlusAdjunctionRight.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} hi))
